base_forms.label: 1 · Orange primary / black secondary
base_forms.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Hexpurr palette concept preview for the ChibiBeasts Halloween game.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED HEXPURR EDIT TARGET, not merely a loose style reference.
Create exactly ONE recolored Hexpurr on a truly transparent background. Keep the reference character's identity, exact cute face, large eye shapes, happy tiny-fanged mouth, seated three-quarter pose with one raised front paw, fluffy chibi proportions, crescent forehead marking, ghost-shaped chest tuft, ear-tip spectral flames, and large curling tail with the friendly ghost flame. Retain the same polished pixel-art rendering, silhouette, pixel edges, shading detail, scale, and composition. Keep the whole character and flame tips visible with a small even transparent margin. Do not redesign the cat.
Change ONLY the color scheme according to the following mapping. Replace the original purple, lavender, mint and large cream markings; this preview must read clearly as the requested two-color palette. Small pale specular highlights and neutral shading are allowed, but no third dominant hue.
No armor, clothes, hat, accessories, scenery, ground, background color, checkerboard, text, labels, borders, extra cats, or added effects. Preserve actual alpha transparency.
Color mapping:
Primary (dominant, about 75% of the solid cat): rich jack-o'-lantern orange fur across head, cheeks, body, all legs, and the solid curling tail, with burnt-orange shadows and warm orange highlights. Secondary: deep charcoal-black inner ears, crescent forehead mark, ghost-shaped chest tuft, toe tips and small fur markings. The chest ghost's facial cutouts read in orange against its black tuft. Keep the spectral ear flames and the tail's ghost flame mostly smoky charcoal-black, outlined by a restrained orange glow so the black ghost remains legible on transparency. Bright orange-amber irises with black pupils. The result MUST be an orange cat with black details, not a black cat with orange lighting.

motion.atlas_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one transparent animation pose atlas for Hexpurr, a cute spooky pixel-art game cat.
Reference 1: approved orange-primary/black-secondary Hexpurr.
Reference 2: approved black-primary/red-secondary Hexpurr.
Reference 3: approved transformation storyboard, for the action poses and mood.
Create a SINGLE SQUARE transparent PNG with exactly FOUR isolated assets in a strict 2-by-2 grid of equal square cells. No grid lines, no text, no labels, no background, no floor, no shadows on a floor, no borders. Every asset stays entirely within its own cell, with at least 8% empty transparent padding from every cell edge. Cells must be cleanly separable by cutting at exactly 50% image width and 50% image height.
Preserve the exact approved Hexpurr facial identity, fluffy chibi body, large pointed ears, tiny fangs, crescent forehead mark, ghost chest tuft, and polished crisp pixel-art style. These are poses for the SAME character, not redesigns. Keep character scale consistent across the three cat cells. Avoid detached limbs, extra legs, or additional cats.
TOP LEFT CELL: ORANGE-primary, BLACK-secondary Hexpurr in a deep anticipation crouch facing right, eyes gently closed in concentration, both front paws planted and shoulders low, haunches tucked. Keep the forehead crescent black, ghost chest tuft black, inner ears black, paw tips black. The large fluffy orange tail is curled behind to the LEFT, but its supernatural ghost flame has been completely drawn away: draw ONLY the solid fluffy tail, NO spectral ghost or ear flames on this crouching asset. This asset is the empty-body pose during spirit intake.
TOP RIGHT CELL: BLACK-primary, RED-secondary Hexpurr performing a forceful low airborne pounce to the RIGHT, body stretched horizontally, both front paws reaching forward, hind paws trailing, determined cute face. Keep red eyes, red crescent, red ghost chest tuft and red paw tips. Tail streams to the LEFT with its recognizable crimson friendly ghost flame. No motion trails or attack slashes: those will be animated separately. The entire cat, tail and flames fit in this cell.
BOTTOM LEFT CELL: BLACK-primary, RED-secondary Hexpurr in a landing/recovery crouch facing right, front paws touching down, haunches lowered, recognizable cute face with open red eyes, black fur and exact red markings. Tail curls back LEFT with its crimson friendly ghost flame. No motion blur or floor. The entire body and flames fit in this cell.
BOTTOM RIGHT CELL: ONLY the detached friendly ghost spirit from reference 1's tail, with the same oval eyes and small smiling mouth: smoky charcoal-black body, warm orange luminous outline and orange face openings. A flowing tapered smoky wisp curves downward from its body. NO cat, NO solid fluffy tail attached, NO props. It must be a clean independent ghost-shaped transparent cutout that can fly into Hexpurr's crescent.
Transparent background with a genuine alpha channel, NOT a checkerboard. Keep the approved orange/black and black/red palettes exactly. No purple or mint. Aim for a clean high-resolution square atlas, with clear separation and sharp beautiful sprite detail.
motion.spacing_edit_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit target: the supplied transparent Hexpurr four-pose atlas.
CHANGE ONLY THE LAYOUT AND SCALE. Preserve exactly the same four beautiful poses, faces, colors, fluffy shapes, markings and ghost spirits. Do not redesign or add anything.
Create a square transparent sprite atlas with a strict two-by-two grid. The previous assets almost touched and crossed cell boundaries. Correct this by shrinking every full asset into the CENTER 60% OF ITS OWN QUADRANT. Leave very generous transparent margins and a wide empty cross-shaped gap through the exact middle of the canvas.
TOP LEFT: orange crouching cat with closed eyes, solid tail, no ghost.
TOP RIGHT: black/red airborne pouncing cat with its complete crimson ghost tail.
BOTTOM LEFT: black/red landing cat with its complete crimson ghost tail.
BOTTOM RIGHT: detached black/orange friendly ghost only.
Each complete character including every flame, paw and tail must be well inside its own quadrant. If the canvas is about 1254 square, place the left objects entirely between x=110 and x=535 and the right objects entirely between x=720 and x=1145. Top objects entirely between y=110 and y=535, bottom between y=720 and y=1145. A very large empty transparent separation is intentional and REQUIRED, even if sprites look smaller.
Only four assets, crisp polished pixel-art rendering, genuine alpha transparency. No background, no grid, no labels, no text, no floor. Do not change anatomy or color mappings. Keep all original details; fit the full assets by scaling them down.

armor.hexpurr_armor_lantern_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE transparent wardrobe sprite-sheet atlas for Hexpurr in the ChibiBeasts game.
Image 1 is the edit target and ONLY character identity: the approved orange-primary/black-secondary Hexpurr.
Image 2 is only the MATERIAL AND ARMOR DESIGN REFERENCE showing the game's 16 existing armor sets on a different creature. Do NOT copy that fox's anatomy, face or pose.
Create one high-resolution square 4-by-4 equal-cell atlas with exactly sixteen FULL Hexpurr sprites. Aim for 2048x2048 or larger so each outfit is readable. All sixteen Hexpurrs keep the EXACT SAME original sitting pose, raised front paw, orientation, cute face, crescent forehead, ghost-shaped chest, ear flames and complete friendly ghost tail. Preserve the orange fur, black secondary markings and amber eyes. Only add properly fitted armor or garments around its torso, shoulders, sides and back. Leave head, ears, paws and ghost tail visible. Do not add new limbs, wings, horns, hats, weapons or floor shadows.
STRICT GRID: Every COMPLETE cat, armor and ghost tail must fit within the central 60% width and height of its exact quarter-sized cell. At least 20% transparent padding on every side in every cell. Large transparent cross-gutters are intentional. No touching or overlap between cells, no contour cropped by the canvas. No labels, no text, no grid lines, no background, genuine RGBA transparency.
Exactly these existing armor sets in left-to-right, top-to-bottom order:
ROW 1:
1 Sprite-Silk: fitted layered emerald leaf tunic with pink silk seams.
2 Gnome-Iron: chunky gray iron body plates, silver edges, brass rivets and small round side buckler.
3 Kelpie-Scale: broad overlapping glossy aqua/teal scales around torso and sides, sparse bubbles.
4 Cinder-Guard: angular obsidian torso vest with one integrated orange molten core.
ROW 2:
5 Unicorn-Healer: flowing white/silver robe, pale lilac folds and silver hem.
6 Basilisk Gaze: moss-gray petrified-eye stone shoulders and torso pieces, amber-slit eye motifs.
7 Phoenix-Born: orange/gold flame-feather cape fitted around the back and flanks, no anatomical wings.
8 Thunderbird: cobalt blue and gold fitted plates with lightning-shaped shoulder spikes.
ROW 3:
9 Dragon-Lord: substantial layered crimson dragon-scale torso and side armor.
10 Abyssal: ragged midnight-indigo shadow cloak, face and tail intact.
11 Chronos Paradox: separated floating gold clockwork body plates and cog wheels, clear gaps, not just jewelry.
12 Blight-Weaver: branching black torso/shoulder armor with violet nebula inlays.
ROW 4:
13 Mossbark: broad wood-grain bark strips around torso with pale silk ties and moss.
14 Emberstone: square gray iron tiles in dark-red ember resin with orange seams, distinct from Cinder-Guard.
15 Thornweave: brown bark and vine cloak with curved thorns and pale feather fringe.
16 Deepwater: dull navy/teal hide panels with cream down lining and broad stitches, distinct from glossy scales.
Match the approved Hexpurr's polished crisp pixel-art treatment. Clothing must look substantial and fit the cat naturally, with the original front paws and fluffy face in front of the garment where appropriate. Keep its signature ghost tail completely unobstructed in every cell. Do not recolor Hexpurr's body to match armor. All 16 must be recognizable as the exact same orange-and-black cat.

TWO COMPLETE figures only, side by side in a 1-row 2-column atlas. LEFT: the exact orange-primary black-secondary cat, amber eyes, dark smoky ghost-tail edged orange. RIGHT: the exact black-primary crimson-red-secondary cat, red eyes and crimson spirit-tail. Same body size, same seated three-quarter pose with one raised forepaw, same direction, same outfit silhouette and pattern. Preserve Hexpurr's cute face, tiny fang, huge triangular ears, forehead crescent, flame ear tips, paws, friendly ghost-tail face. Costume: a small warm-ivory linen ghost poncho with soft pale-lavender shadow folds, a snug open-face hood (face/crescent fully visible), tailored openings so both ears and flames stay free, same scalloped pointed rag hem, forepaw openings, and ONE tiny stitched orange jack-o-lantern patch at the lower front hem on BOTH forms. ChibiBeasts detailed chunky pixel fantasy sprite style of the approved cats. Generous transparent margin around EVERY extremity: each full figure including flame tips and ghost tail fits in central 75% of its own half. No text, captions, labels, dividers or scene background.
ghost_costume.spacing: Spacing correction only for this approved-design preview. Recreate these EXACT TWO Hexpurr cats in their matching ivory/lavender little ghost hooded ponchos with matching orange pumpkin patches, side-by-side, with every color, clothing cut, fold and pose kept the same. Reduce BOTH COMPLETE FIGURES to 75 percent of their current rendered size, centered in their half of the canvas. The topmost ear flames must be COMPLETE, and no edge may touch the canvas boundary. Leave a broad transparent band above all flames and below all paws, plus transparent left/right and center gutters. Each entire cat plus its ghost tail is fully visible. No cropping, no zoom, no added costume elements, no background or text. True transparent background.

approval: User approved the orange/black and black/red forms, native Lanterns Out choreography, open crimson aura, both 16-outfit wardrobes, and matching ghost costumes before integration.
